newsitem.title: USA: ONYX PHARMA, WARNER-LAMBERT IN PACT.
newsitem.headline: ONYX PHARMA, WARNER-LAMBERT IN PACT.

text.p: Onyx Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday that it and Warner-Lambert Co have established a three-year research and development agreement aimed at discovering new therapeutics to regulate inflammation and autoimmunity.
In a press release, Onyx said that specific financial terms of the agreement are not disclosed, but that total payments to Onyx prior to commercialization could total nearly $30 million.

The goal of the collaboration is to identify specific enzymes and other intracellular proteins that play a role in the development of inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, and to develop small molecule therapeutics that interact with these proteins and inhibit their ability to cause disease.

The companies are focusing on acute inflammatory disorders, such as adult respiratory distress syndrome and reperfusion injury; and chronic inflammatory disorders, such as arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, asthma and psoriasis.
Terms of the agreement provide for Onyx to receive an up-front licensing fee payable in three stages, as well as milestone payments and royalties on eventual product sales.
